name: Urmila Mujahirudin
original_name: ウルミラ・ムジャヒルディーン
source:
She is a talented cross dressing butler who came to the Turner family to replace her grandfather who was disabled by illness.

The reason she left her previous home was because the master there was about to put his hands on her. She was humiliated that she was seen not as a butler but as a woman. She is both happy and resentful to be seen as a woman.

[From [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/7363]official site[/url]]
